headline: Colonials Seize The Parras as Gutter Front Flares Anew
war_summary: The freshest dispatch since our last edition comes from the Gutter, where Colonial forces have taken The Parras from Warden hands, the change of flag logged at the very hour this paper goes to press. Fort Ember on Fisherman's Row, raised to Warden colors in our prior report, shows no further movement. The Stonecradle stands as the busiest field of the day, seventeen recorded actions splitting its posts six Colonial to three Warden, with The Reach and World's End the most troubled ground and the casualty bill climbing steeply on both sides. The Linn of Mercy's base actions have thinned to a trickle, yet its ledger stays ruinously heavy against the Wardens. The Weathered Expanse grinds on six posts to three, Crow's Nest still its liveliest point. The Dead Lands near Callahan's Gate bleed anew, losses falling hardest on Warden columns, while along the Nevish Line the Colonial toll runs higher. Marban Hollow and the Stlican Shelf, the latter held five to four, exchange heavy fire without settled result. Day 320 closes with no victor declared; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
